info.title: Globe Play Private Developer API
info.description: Authenticated developer organization workspace reads and invitation/ownership operations. All responses are private, no-store and noindex. Requests require a server-validated BrightGlobe canonical session. App management endpoints create, list and update private draft apps and localized listing revisions.

post.description: Creates the organization and its initial active owner in one transaction. The response is private and never shared-cacheable.

get.summary: List organizations for the authenticated user
get.description: Returns only organizations where the authenticated canonical user has an active membership. Response is private and never shared-cacheable.

200.description: Organizations visible to the authenticated user

post.description: Owner or Admin authorization is enforced inside the transaction service. Only non-owner membership roles are accepted; the invite is delivered to the supplied email.
Requires a verified email session. Only the current Owner can initiate. The recipient must accept with a verified email session before ownership changes.
Requires a verified Better Auth email session. The single-use token is sent in the request body rather than a URL to reduce access-log and referrer leakage.

get.description: Requires active membership in the requested organization. Members see active team display names and roles. Only Owner and Admin see pending invitation email addresses. Cross-tenant access returns 404.

200.description: Tenant-scoped workspace; active member display names and roles are visible to members. Pending invitation email addresses are visible only to Owner/Admin. Each pending invitation includes canRevoke, computed from server-side role and initiating-owner checks. Always private no-store.

404.description: Organization not found or not accessible

get.summary: List apps in a developer organization

post.summary: Create an app or game draft

patch.summary: Update an editable localized app draft

404.description: App or draft locale not found

get.description: Returns active Globe-managed categories for the requested locale. Developers may select but cannot create or edit taxonomy. The response is private and tenant-membership scoped.
